# SubSpace Core (SSC) billing protocol. Layouts from ASSS 1.4.4
# src/packets/billing.h compiled unmodified; sizes and field values follow the send
# sites in src/core/billing_ssc.c (quoted in README). All fields little-endian, packed.
# layout <struct> <sizeof>
# field <struct> <name> <offset> <size>
# s2b/b2s <name> <length as sent> <bytes>
# Every packet rides the reliable layer (NET_RELIABLE) on a client connection the zone
# opens to the biller; the biller never acknowledges the connect packet.
layout PlayerScore 14
field PlayerScore Kills 0 2
field PlayerScore Deaths 2 2
field PlayerScore Flags 4 2
field PlayerScore Score 6 4
field PlayerScore FlagScore 10 4
layout S2B_ServerConnect 173
field S2B_ServerConnect Type 0 1
field S2B_ServerConnect ServerID 1 4
field S2B_ServerConnect GroupID 5 4
field S2B_ServerConnect ScoreID 9 4
field S2B_ServerConnect ServerName 13 126
field S2B_ServerConnect Port 139 2
field S2B_ServerConnect Password 141 32
